dialogues.speaker: "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness"
dialogues.text: Hey, Itto, this is your second time organizing this sort of musical event, right? Haha, didn't think you'd move the stage to Watatsumi Island — opposite Sangonomiya Shrine, no less. Very cool!

dialogues.speaker: "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness"
dialogues.text: I asked our Clan Head, and it was agreed that we dispatch a team from Komore Teahouse to help liven up the atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness"
dialogues.text: They'll provide tourists with free tea. What do you think? Pretty sweet, eh?

dialogues.speaker: "Iridescent Arataki Rockin' for Life Tour de Force of Awesomeness"
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it, you're welcome. I'm happy as long as you are!
